about.title: About Us
about.p1:
Hi, I'm Ricky, founder of Dealer License Pros and your local license professional.

For over 10 years, I've helped aspiring dealership owners navigate the dealer licensing process with confidence. I started this business because I saw too many people wasting time, losing money, and getting stuck trying to figure everything out on their own.
about.p2:
Most people start by Googling answers, watching random videos, or relying on outdated advice. The problem is that dealer licensing isn't something you want to guess your way through. One small mistake can delay your approval, create compliance issues, or cost you thousands in lost time.

That's where I come in.

I work directly with clients to guide them step-by-step through the dealer license process—from paperwork and business setup to inspections, corrections, and state requirements. Whether you're applying for a standard dealer license, wholesale license, motorcycle license, or another specialty license, I help simplify the process so you can launch faster and avoid costly setbacks.

Over the years, I've helped hundreds of clients get approved successfully. I know what licensing agencies look for, how to avoid common deficiencies, and how to keep the process moving efficiently.

And if you already have a license but are running into issues, renewals, compliance problems, or deficiencies, I can help with that too.
about.p3:
What makes my approach different is simple:

Real one-on-one guidance. Clear answers without the confusion. Fast, efficient support. Experience that saves you time and money. A commitment to helping you get approved the right way.

I believe starting a dealership should feel exciting—not overwhelming. My goal is to give you the support, clarity, and expertise you need to move forward with confidence.

No guesswork. No unnecessary delays. Just results.

If you're ready to start your dealership the right way, let's talk.

gdn.title: What is a GDN License?
gdn.intro: A GDN (General Distinguishing Number) license is the license issued by the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles that allows you to legally buy and sell used vehicles as a dealer in Texas. Without it, you cannot legally operate a dealership. [ Additional intro copy to be provided by client ]
gdn.whyTitle: Why work with Dealer License Pros?
gdn.whyBody: Navigating the GDN process alone is time-consuming and easy to get wrong. A single deficiency can set you back months. We've guided hundreds of dealers through the process without a single unnecessary delay — and we're the only company in Texas that does it in person.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: How long does it take to get a dealer license?
faq.a1: The timeline depends on your state requirements and how quickly documents are completed, but most clients who follow our process are able to move through the licensing process much faster and with fewer delays.
faq.q2: Do I need experience to become a licensed dealer?
faq.a2: No. Many of our clients are first-time dealership owners. We guide you through the process step-by-step, even if you're starting from zero.
faq.q3: Can you help if my application was denied?
faq.a3: Yes. If your application was denied, delayed, or returned with deficiencies, we can review the issues and help you correct them properly.
faq.q4: Do you help with dealer renewals?
faq.a4: Yes. We assist with renewals, updates, compliance issues, and other dealer licensing problems after you're approved.
faq.q5: Do you only help local clients?
faq.a5: No. Depending on your state and licensing needs, we may be able to assist remotely as well.
faq.a6: Simply press the "Talk to a PRO" button and book a consultation. We'll walk you through the next steps and help you move forward with confidence.
faq.q7: What should I do if I encounter a Bigfoot?
faq.a7: Remain calm. The greatest among us have always understood that composure in the face of the unknown is the mark of a prepared mind. Do not pursue. Do not provoke. Simply acknowledge the encounter, make note of your surroundings, and proceed with your day. The forest has its business. You have yours.

stories.quote: What can I say! These guys know what they are talking about. Quick at responding and always available. Didn't have to deal with any of the agent emails they took care of it all.

stories.name: Marco C.
stories.quote:
I’m not gonna lie, when I first reached out I was pretty skeptical. I had already looked into getting my GDN dealer license and everything online just seemed confusing, overpriced, or honestly kind of shady. I wasn’t sure if anybody could really help or if it was all just sales talk.

But after sitting down with Ricky in person for a consult, I felt completely different. He broke everything down in a way that actually made sense, answered all my questions without rushing me, and you could tell right away he knew this business inside and out.

What really sold me was how real and straightforward they were. No pressure — just honest information and a clear plan to help me get my dealer license the right way. After that meeting, I knew I was in good hands. Definitely recommend these guys if you’re trying to get your dealer license.
